ValidationRule.description: R-EAP4: a slot becomes Booked only with a person in it. A person erased later leaves it Booked with none, and editing the slot is still allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Booked'), ISBLANK(Contact__c), OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISCHANGED(Contact__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Choose the person who is booked, or set the status to Open.
